excerpt: Why is Linear fast? Not "good engineering" fast. Fast like local software, on a network product, with multiplayer. The answer is an architecture, and thanks to Tuomas Artman's talks plus one obsessive reverse-engineering repo (Artman: "probably the best documentation that exists"), we know exactly which one: the client owns a replica, the server's job is ordering and reconciliation. The industry settled on a name for the family: sync engines. The server is becoming a cache.
title: The server is just a cache
